Package com.jpexs.decompiler.flash.tags.base

Interface BinaryDataInterface

All Superinterfaces:
Exportable, TreeItem
All Known Implementing Classes:
DefineBinaryDataTag, PackedBinaryData
public interface BinaryDataInterface extends Exportable
Interface for binary data objects. It is a DefineBinaryData tag and its subdata.
